changeSet.sql: WITH credential_family(dtype, access_name, family) AS ( VALUES ('DeviceSnmpv1Community', 'snmpv1', 'snmp'), ('DeviceSnmpv2cCommunity', 'snmpv2c', 'snmp'), ('DeviceSnmpv3Community', 'snmpv3', 'snmp'), ('DeviceSshAccount', 'ssh', 'cli'), ('DeviceSshKeyAccount', 'ssh', 'cli'), ('DeviceTelnetAccount', 'telnet', 'cli') ) INSERT INTO device_access (device, access_name, specific_credential_set) SELECT d.id, cf.access_name, d.specific_credential_set FROM device d JOIN device_credential_set dcs ON dcs.id = d.specific_credential_set JOIN credential_family cf ON cf.dtype = dcs.dtype WHERE cf.family = CASE WHEN d.driver = 'GenericSNMP' THEN 'snmp' ELSE 'cli' END ON CONFLICT (device, access_name) DO UPDATE SET specific_credential_set = EXCLUDED.specific_credential_set, global_credential_set = NULL;

WITH credential_family(dtype, access_name, family) AS ( VALUES ('DeviceSnmpv1Community', 'snmpv1', 'snmp'), ('DeviceSnmpv2cCommunity', 'snmpv2c', 'snmp'), ('DeviceSnmpv3Community', 'snmpv3', 'snmp'), ('DeviceSshAccount', 'ssh', 'cli'), ('DeviceSshKeyAccount', 'ssh', 'cli'), ('DeviceTelnetAccount', 'telnet', 'cli') ), winner AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (dcs.device) dcs.device AS device_id, dcs.credential_sets AS cs_id, cf.access_name, cf.family FROM device_credential_sets dcs JOIN device_credential_set c ON c.id = dcs.credential_sets JOIN credential_family cf ON cf.dtype = c.dtype JOIN device dd ON dd.id = dcs.device WHERE COALESCE(c.device_specific, FALSE) = FALSE AND cf.family = CASE WHEN dd.driver = 'GenericSNMP' THEN 'snmp' ELSE 'cli' END ORDER BY dcs.device, dcs.credential_sets ) INSERT INTO device_access (device, access_name, global_credential_set) SELECT w.device_id, w.access_name, w.cs_id FROM winner w JOIN device d ON d.id = w.device_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM device_credential_set sc JOIN credential_family scf ON scf.dtype = sc.dtype WHERE sc.id = d.specific_credential_set AND scf.family = w.family ) ON CONFLICT (device, access_name) DO UPDATE SET global_credential_set = EXCLUDED.global_credential_set, specific_credential_set = NULL;

WITH access_family(access_name, family) AS ( VALUES ('snmpv1', 'snmp'), ('snmpv2c', 'snmp'), ('snmpv3', 'snmp'), ('ssh', 'cli'), ('telnet', 'cli') ), credential_family(dtype, family) AS ( VALUES ('DeviceSnmpv1Community', 'snmp'), ('DeviceSnmpv2cCommunity', 'snmp'), ('DeviceSnmpv3Community', 'snmp'), ('DeviceSshAccount', 'cli'), ('DeviceSshKeyAccount', 'cli'), ('DeviceTelnetAccount', 'cli') ) INSERT INTO device_access (device, access_name) SELECT d.id, af.access_name FROM device d JOIN access_family af ON af.family = CASE WHEN d.driver = 'GenericSNMP' THEN 'snmp' ELSE 'cli' END WHERE d.auto_try_credentials = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM device_credential_set sc JOIN credential_family cf ON cf.dtype = sc.dtype WHERE sc.id = d.specific_credential_set AND cf.family = af.family ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM device_credential_sets dcs JOIN device_credential_set c ON c.id = dcs.credential_sets JOIN credential_family cf ON cf.dtype = c.dtype WHERE dcs.device = d.id AND COALESCE(c.device_specific, FALSE) = FALSE AND cf.family = af.family ) ON CONFLICT (device, access_name) DO NOTHING;
